chars.DATE: The same earnest young man appears: late 20s, neat dark hair, denim jacket over a white tee.

scenes.content: Across a small cafe table, the earnest young man is mid-question with polite enthusiasm while she rests her chin in her hand, eyes glazed with polite exhaustion. Black and white.
scenes.motion: black and white film. his lips move earnestly; she blinks slowly, chin in hand; steam rises from the cups

scenes.content: A different earnest young man mid-sentence across a different diner table, the same young woman with the same glazed politeness, a different cafe. Black and white.
scenes.motion: black and white film. the new man gestures mid-question; she nods on autopilot; a waiter passes behind

scenes.content: She slides her phone across the cafe table toward the earnest young man with one raised eyebrow and a small knowing smile, warm color blooming into the scene.
scenes.motion: the phone slides across the table; color warms the scene; her eyebrow lifts
